name: cache-warm
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm: a band above the prompt counts down the cache's life and pings it with a tiny forked request just before it lapses, so the next reply reads the context at a fraction of the price.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the API keeps the prompt cache after a reply: "5m" (the API default) or "1h" (the extended cache, which subscriptions get). The engine does not report which one a reply set, so say it here.

maxPings.title: Pings per reply
maxPings.description: The most pings sent after one reply before the cache is left to go cold. Each ping reads the whole context from cache, about 5 to 10% of its uncached price.
